review: Full public English automatic captions, 00:00-02:26.375, read; all 32 sampled frames viewed on two contact sheets. Video duration 146.22 seconds. Automatic captions may misrecognize words. No trade audit.

principles.idea: The speakers focus on the migrated section of a launch feed, particularly for beginners.
Compare current narratives with both coins that performed well and coins that performed badly today.
Look for current cultural attention and meme circulation, with TikTok as an example, rather than relying on an unfamiliar ticker alone.

interpretation: Record the theme, timestamped social observation and a comparison scope including positive, negative and missing outcomes. These are manual notes; the system validates their binding and time, not the truth of their contents.
not_adopted: The caption's 100x claim is not an established return or prediction.
An unfamiliar meme, a low market cap or absence from one personalized feed is not proof of scam.
Migration and popularity do not establish safety or token authenticity.
automation_limits: No automatic TikTok/X post reading, trend measurement, peer-performance verification or migration confirmation. Scanner-only snapshots produce UNKNOWN context. No market-cap/social safety-rule changes.
validation_plan: Before new outcomes, freeze theme tags, selection scope and evidence timestamps for every considered coin, including rejected candidates. Compare later same-pool outcomes on a time-ordered holdout with losses, unknowns and costs. Manual notes and post-entry replay are not prospective validation. Existing trial scores and results stay unchanged.
